# Web app routes

53 routes in `apps/web/app/` (Next.js App Router). Folders in brackets are values taken from the address (`[id]`); folders in parentheses group files without changing the address. Pages in the *signed in* group redirect to `/login` when there is no session; *admin* pages also need an admin account.
